local gui = game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
local inset = game:GetService('GuiService'):GetGuiInset()
local out = {}
for _, pt in { {1333, 462, 'dash'}, {1350, 68, 'pause'}, {700, 260, 'world'} } do
	local list = gui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(pt[1], pt[2] - inset.Y)
	local names = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(7, #list) do
		local o = list[i]
		table.insert(names, string.format('%s(%s%s z%d)', o.Name, o.ClassName, o.Active and ' Active' or '', o.ZIndex))
	end
	table.insert(out, pt[3] .. ': ' .. table.concat(names, ' > '))
end
return 'inset=' .. tostring(inset) .. '\n' .. table.concat(out, '\n')
